notes.title: Changelog v1.0
notes.notes:
We're here!

Changelog v1.0.00

- Fixed localization errors for a few NPCs' names.
- Changed challenges in contests that were almost impossible to complete.
- Fixed quest logs for quests that are sub-quests (children of another quest).
- Fixed quest logs for quests that shouldn't appear anymore.
- Fixed Nix's broken quest flow.
- Fixed the Teacher's quest flow.
- Fixed battles starting in the wrong stage environment.
- Fixed the bug reporting UI input map.
- Fixed Photoshoot mode getting stuck during a few side quests.

notes.title: Full Release - Patch Notes - v0.9.76 to v0.9.89
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We finally made it! With this update, Cosplay Club is now fully playable from start to the epic final boss battle!

It’s been a wild five-year journey, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Your support has meant the world to us, especially through all the ups and downs—studio changes, the pandemic, health challenges, and the loss of loved ones. Knowing you were out there, cheering us on, kept us going when things got tough.

We poured our hearts into this game, and we hope you love the complete experience. We can't wait to hear your thoughts, see your reactions, and watch how you take on the final boss!

Thank you for being with us every step of the way. You are truly the best community we could ask for.

Cheers!
Behold Studio's Team

notes.title: New update! Tons of fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942929/c5e7427ea58fc22558dc21e904506486f40134c3.png[/img]

In this patch, we have a multitude of fixes, updates, and even new content! However, we want to convey an important message to you to prevent any potential misunderstandings:

Regarding some of these changes, especially the new additions, if you have already played through some specific parts you won’t be able to access it in this save file. If you want to guarantee the access of these stuff and to experience our fixes in the early game progression you need to create a new game and start over. We are trying to make it more fun and enjoyable right at the start! 

We understand that these situations are not optimal, and rest assured, we always try to avoid them at all costs. However, they are necessary from time to time to enhance early experiences.

We hope you can all understand and appreciate the effort we’re putting into the game. ❤️

[list]
[*] Now you can battle against some massive bully mech-hands.
[*] New unlockables for your room! Can you collect all the toys? Find their quests!
[*] Game Difficulty Settings now offer additional options, helping with the game accessibility.
[*] - Beware! The highiest difficulty is.... high. We'll still be monitoring and refining it.
[*] Goddess booths now have dev-ine protection against rogue robots.
[*] Added more interactions with multiple objects around the convention center.
[*] Added new Wait-type Skills for you to mess around with.
[*] Added simple animations in many booths to help the game feel less static.
[*] Added area of effect skill preview for the Enemy Tank and Enemy Hand.
[*] Fixed a major issue causing inconsistent UI behaviour for the Next Objetive HUD, it feels good to know why and where you're headed.
[*] Fixed an issue where some Quests wouldn't start at the right time, like the Cardboard Hoarder Quest, for example.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Shop UI wouldn't function correctly in certain resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where Enemy Hand would cast vanish and prematurely end battles in the first round.
[*] Fixed an issue where the vSync settings wasn't saving properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where having more than 16 items in your inventory would break the system... ??
[*] Fixed an issue with some hats' pivot points to make them easier to attach to the head.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Summon Unity Haste visual.
[*] Updated the initial number of available shoes in the game.
[*] Updated Enemy Ranged Sci Fi visuals.
[*] Updated Enemy Cosplayer #20 visuals.
[*] Updated Toy Convention Contest type.
[*] Updated Crafting UI for better readability.
[*] Updated Galaxy Shop.
[*] Updated Rahul Shop.
[*] Updated Emma Shop.
[*] Updated Challenge Carnival Quests.
[*] Updated Pin Catalogue pin's order by type.
[*] Updated the minimum font size in the Event Planner UI for better readability.
[*] Updated NPC Portraits with new faces.
[*] Localization Fixes and Updates:
[*] - Crafting UI
[*] - Player Skills
[*] - Default Blueprints Models: This was causing the default blueprints to not work in other languages.
[*] - Cleaned up multiple texts to avoid artifacts caused by hidden characters.
[*] And much more!
[/list]

notes.title: High Tech Major Update!
notes.notes:
Major new content has arrived!

The second arc of main quest and the Boss #2 have been added to the game along with various side quests.

Decorations with Animated Effects: Now you can create costumes with fire, stars, electricity and much more! You can unlock them by winning contests, so prepare your best costume and collect them all!
We've worked on many updates and adjustments to ensure the second arc is ready for you guys to play, and we hope you enjoy as much as we do. <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942929/d9e1122a5b0a14cd73e73e022aacc277c31da649.png[/img]

Patch Notes v0.9.47

- Battle Changes
	- Tank Minion's area damage now hits its own allies.
	- Fixed an issue where characters would rotate 360 degrees after an attack.
- Contest Bosses from side quests now reward you with their VFX Decoration when defeated.
- Updated Eric textures; now he is a fancy boy.
- Updated the "Head" category to "Hair".
- Updated cameras in Sci-fi Contest to avoid unwanted booth photo-bombing your dialogs.
- Updated the quest log text layout to improve readability.
- Updated tooltips to improve readability and usability.
- Fixed an issue where Boss #1||, Layla,|| would lay down on the ground because why not.
- Fixed an issue that would cause inconsistent sorting with the quest log list.
- Fixed an issue with the inventory label size.
- Fixed an issue with the blueprint when saving with the "Unsaved blueprint" name.
- Fixed the position of the Pin Catalogue OK button.
- Fixed an issue that was causing buggy Skill descriptions.
- Fixed an issue with the teleport-type Skills that would cause inconsistent movement.
- Fixed various issues with shop items.
- Fixed an issue where Contest Characters would speak using the wrong UI.
- Fixed an issue where the blueprint creation's scrollbar was resetting to the top after adding a decoration.
- Fixed a lot of missing localization texts, like, a LOT.

[b]Come play now![/b]

notes.title: Paparazzi Update
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the Paparazzi update, v0.9.41, now live during our Steam Early Access phase! This update brings you a bunch of bug fixes and introduces two major features that we believe you're going to love:

[list][*] [b]Character Customization[/b]: Dive deeper into personalization with the new option to pick your character's face in the character creation suite. Make your avatar truly yours!
[*] [b]Enhanced Photo Mode[/b]: Capture your best moments in even more options with expanded options in the Photo Mode. Get ready to unleash your creativity and share your favorite snapshots![/list]

We're committed to enhancing your experience and bringing your feedback to life. Update now and let the new features inspire your next Cosplay Club adventure!

Thank you for your continued support. Happy gaming!

[h1]Patch Notes v0.9.41[/h1]

- Added new features:
	- New faces! Now you can choose between different faces in the Character Creation when starting a new game.
	- Now you can choose the NPC pose during Photomode.
	- Now the player and NPC both look at the camera when taking a photo in Photomode.
	- Player Battle portrait is now fully working and it shows your current character with your current costume.
- New Photo Social Quests were added so the Player can have more ways of interacting with the Photomode feature.
- Fixed an issue where taking a Photo with Photomode wouldn't send it to Steam's Screenshots system.
	- Now you can share your favorite photos with your friends!
- Fixed an issue where interacting with Photomode in Battle would prevent the Movement's UI tip from closing.
- Fixed an issue where the Photomode camera would't rotate anymore.
- Fixed an issue where the Battle's UI would disappear in the second phase of Layla's Battle.
- Fixed an issue where the Challenge's UI wasn't being updated after the first Contest Battle.
- Fixed an issue where the player could walk out of his turn after exiting photomode.
- Fixed an issue where users wouldn't read the patch notes by randomly thanking them for their support and love.
- Fixed an issue with the Battle Dialog's UI that would cause inconsistent length-based resizes.
- Fixed several issues with the distribution of unique items in shops.
- Thank you all for your support and love <3
- Updated the AI Behaviour of the Medieval Tank Enemy to better suit its purpose.
- Layla & Baggy now talk about wearing theme-fittings cosplays to cons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942929/acf2ee399afc48483155ecc6852dada83c333d38.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.9.37
notes.notes:
Hey! Happy new year y'all! Here are the Patch Notes for the latest version of the game. We wanted to start the year with some bug fixes so we can then start to add new stuff to the game!

- Bug Report screen now sends your game log and save file.
	- This will help us immensely to track and fix bugs from now on.
- Fixed an issue where Erika would appear next to e-shoujo live show's stage.
- Fixed an issue that would cause the player to interact with the event exits without them wanting to.
- Fixed an issue where the Dark Color Palette would not have the correct tag.
	- Now you can use this color to craft a costume with Dark tag.
- Added Enemy Training name and description that was missing.
- Changed the requisite for a few Random Battle Quests.
- Added localization for Layla's summons and allies.
- Updated dialog cameras for the following quests:
	- The mysterious material thief.
	- The sprint pirates club.
	- A cosplayer's beginning.
	- A cosplayer's dream.
- Fixed an issue where Layla would appear earlier than expected.
- Fixed an issue where the player could be stuck in some booths.
- Fixed several internal handling exceptions that could be causing a lot of snowball bugs.
- Fixed an issue where using Photomode near an interaction could soft-lock the game.
- Fixed an issue where using Photomode in Battle could cause an infinite white loading screen.
- Fixed an issue where the Photomode's UI would conflit with the Battle's UI.

Cheers! Have fun and make new costumes!

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9.34
notes.notes:
Hey! We just released a patch to improve the overall experience of the game. Specially on those first hours. We hope you like it.

- Now it's more probable to fight 2 or more enemies, rather than just one.
- Passive frontliner cost reduction: 3 -> 1
- Passive harmonic movement cost reduction:  2 -> 1
- Enemycosplayer_16 with correct description
- Fixed some texts in speech bubbles on Victory screen
- A big amount of internal system fixes and error handling, while opening shop, cellphone, loading quests, loading costume designs and inventory.
- Fixed naming validation in the costume design creation when it is a new blueprint
- Fixed stuck on fadeout (black screen) after winning a contest
- Contest challenge counter fixed
- Some updates to camera views during the main quest (Layla)
- New active skills in the beginning of the game! We want you to have more interesting choices right from the start.
- Overall price fix for all PINs and costume design parts

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9.28
notes.notes:
Hey beautiful people! Here are the Patch Notes v0.9.28 for the new version. This is our first release candidate for the Early Access coming on Dec 14th, Thursday. Let us know what you think!

- Event NPC UI rework. New pop-up animation and icons. Now you can see its name and the type of interaction you are gonna get before interacting with the NPC.
    - Battle
    - Photo
    - Quests
    - Dialog
- New icons for the Load and Download buttons at the Blueprint Screen.
- Fixed an issue where the game would not know what to do when saving a blueprint with a name already used.
- Fixed an issue where Carnival Challenge Side Quest had the wrong NPCs.
- Fixed an issue where some pins had missing descriptions.
- Fixed an issue where Erika was congratulating the player about winning the princess contest with some delay.
- Fixed an issue where the description of the Room Decoration Quest wasn't very clear about its reward.
- Fixed an issue where the Community Support's Pop-up confirmation UI was appearing in the wrong position.
- Fixed an issue where enemies in battle were trying to select a target before they should.
- Fixed an issue that prevented the passives from working.
    - Added 6 new passives to the game for you to unlock!
    - Updated some passive descriptions.
- Fixed some missing event booth colliders.
- Fixed a visual error on Pin Catalogue UI when showing the list of pins.
- Fixed an issue where the button for the Blueprint Editor screen wasn't correctly aligned.
- Fixed various issues that were causing some inconsistencies in how the player interacts with the game. This fixed some screen-stuck related issues as well.
- Fixed an issue that caused some summons not to load their model.
- Added new Battle Quests that can only be played if the player is wearing the events' tags.
- Temporarily removed the joystick/gamepad support.
    - We plan to fully support joystick/gamepad as early as possible in early access but, because we can't fix its current problems right now, we are temporarily removing our support to avoid any unnecessary problem.
- Fixed an issue where the Cute Contest was missing the NPC.
- Updated Mari Quest Reward.
- Updated the name of Emma's Quest in the Juliet Quest.
- Skip, you say? Yes! You can now skip the Henshin scene by holding SPACE for 1 second.
    - (Tech art whispers: But you shouldn't, it took too much effort for you to skip it <3)
- Fixed an issue where the color picker for the hair was missing the Grayscale Palette.
- Fixed a bug we created trying to fix another bug.
    - (Welcome to game dev.)
- Fixed an issue where the days were passing when they shouldn't.
- Bally now comments about "more crafting slots = more pins".
- Updated Quest, Victory and Defeat screens.
- Fixed an issue where the Early Access Screen was showing at the end of every quest.
- Fixed an issue where the Shop would not show pin stats.

Thanks to the community for helping us find the bugs and make sure nothing goes unseen! xD

notes.title: Playing our Alpha version for the first time publicly!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942929/7f40be03e7fc10c63dfd8bf108319f3475c5ccc0.png[/img]

Hey all! Steam Next Fest is here!

Kali de Los Santos, the narrative designer behind Mahou Senshi Cosplay Club, will be playing and showcasing our alpha version of the game. This is the first time that we're playing it during a live. 

They'll be showing an incomplete but never seen version of some features, a very exclusive peek of what is coming to the final version of the game! 

We hope you come along and enjoy it!
Don't forget to wishlist the game!
